summary: Frontend-only iteration 2 testing complete. All requested UI/nav/deep-link/legal content changes verified working. Nav has no 'Home' link (Coaching, Methodology, About, Echo, Contact only). Coaching link scrolls to coaching-hero. Logo click scrolls to top. Echo button reads 'Find Real Connection' and scrolls to #joinbeta claim form. ClaimForm reads ?ref= only via useEffect on mount — fine for current SPA usage; won't update if query changes without remount.
